notes: Also re-ran pre-existing pdf-import-review-confirm and entries-order-b3-classification browser checks as regression sweep (both passed) though they map to criteria outside this iteration's matrix, so not listed as separate checks[] entries to avoid double-counting against the 8-criterion cap; full pass confirmed no regressions from the cross-site cookie fix.

The new cross-site iframe check uses https://example.com as a genuine third-party parent origin (not same-site), embeds the public preview URL in an iframe, and drives the login/reload/logout flow entirely inside the iframe's own document - this is the strongest available proxy for 'parent site with a different origin' without control of a second real domain.

Confirmed via curl that localhost:8001 (plain HTTP) intentionally omits Secure/Partitioned/SameSite=None and instead sets SameSite=Lax - this is correct HTTPS-only behavior, not a bug; the dedicated backend test therefore targets the public HTTPS APP_URL for this specific criterion.
